versions.subject: rule: ProxyLogon rule for MS Exchange
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    Message|contains|all: 
        - 'OabVirtualDirectory'
        - ' -ExternalUrl '
selection_params:
    Message|contains:
        - 'eval(request'
        - 'http://f/<script'
        - '"unsafe"};'
        - 'function Page_Load()'
condition: selection_cmdlet and selection_params
